name: io.github.verygoodplugins/mcp-edd
description: Query your EDD store's sales, customers, products, and analytics from Claude
long_description:
Query your EDD store's sales, customers, and products directly from Claude. Get instant insights into revenue, customer behavior, and product performance.

**What you can do:**

• Sales Analytics - "Show me this month's revenue" or "Compare Q4 sales to last year"
• Customer Insights - "Find customers who purchased WP Fusion" or "Show top 10 by lifetime value"
• Product Data - "List all products with their sales stats" or "Show pricing for premium tier"
• Discount Tracking - "Which discount codes were used this week?"

Built by Very Good Plugins, the team behind WP Fusion - trusted by 10,000+ WordPress sites for CRM and marketing integrations.

edd_api_url.title: Store API URL
edd_api_url.description: Your EDD store API endpoint (must end with /edd-api/, e.g., https://example.com/edd-api/)

edd_api_key.title: API Key
edd_api_key.description: Your EDD API public key (found in Downloads → Settings → API)

edd_api_token.title: API Token
edd_api_token.description: Your EDD API token (found in Downloads → Settings → API)
